title: ChatGPT can transcribe as you speak now with Live Dictation
slides: Is OpenAI making typing obsolete with Live Dictation?
It transcribes your speech in real time inside ChatGPT
But accuracy breaks down in noisy or accented conditions
You can now draft messages without touching the keyboard
Test it on your messiest audio before trusting it
thread_text:
1. OpenAI's typing killer?

Live Dictation inside ChatGPT transcribes your speech as you talk. No keyboard needed, but it's not flawless.

2. Real-time transcription

The feature works directly in ChatGPT, converting spoken words to text instantly. You can draft messages without touching keys.

3. Accuracy breaks down

Noisy rooms or strong accents cause errors. The tool struggles when conditions aren't ideal.

4. Draft without typing

You can now compose emails, posts, or notes just by speaking. It's faster for rough drafts, but editing may still be needed.

5. Test it first

Try Live Dictation on your messiest audio—a loud café or a heavy accent. If it fails, you'll know before trusting it.

instagram.caption:
You can now talk to ChatGPT and watch the words appear as you speak. 🎙️

Live Dictation transcribes your voice in real time inside the app, so you can draft a message without touching the keyboard.

One catch: noisy rooms and strong accents trip it up, and accuracy drops fast.

If you write for a living, this could speed up rough drafts, but you'll still need to edit before publishing.

Try it on your messiest audio first, a loud café or your heaviest accent. Would you trust it with a client message? 🤔
